title: Perfect but not so perfect
body:
It's totally a good app but there are many bugs and I know they're working on that so I'm going to remind the bugs I know (just in case):
You can't delete tags, you can't organize your tasks, when you accept a challenge the button disapears just if you refresh, you can't use brutal smash (in my case) for task that are labeled as the last, it takes a while before you can interact with your party's details. 
That's it, the ones I've spot good luck with them :)
author: @Julito29
